verdict.rationale: Asana markets 'AI Teammates' with Work Graph context and 'Asana Dash' as an 'AI Chief of Staff', suggesting some conversational AI querying of workspace content, but there is no documentation confirming an instant Q&A feature that returns answers with explicit citations from workspace content. Missing for 10: documentation of a chat/ask interface, evidence of citation formatting or source-linking, and any hands-on confirmation of accuracy or usage.
